description: IFRS-style Income Statement for an investment-holding entity. Mirrors the structure used by holding companies that report dividends, interest, equity-method share of associates' results, and OCI-adjacent items (realised gains on AFS securities, fair-value re-evaluations). Pre-defined rows are bound to flags — go to Reports → Account map to bind each flag to the matching GL accounts in your chart of accounts. Designed to be rendered with the 'Quarterly + Quarter-YTD (interleaved)' granularity for board-pack presentation.

rows.label: Revenues
Dividends from Available for Sale Securities
Equity Share in Net Profit/(Loss) of Associated Company
Re-evaluation/Impairment Charge for Available for Sale
Income from Banks (Interest on Fixed Deposits)
Prior Years Adjustment / Re-evaluation of Invest. in Associated Co.
Other Income
Total Gains (Losses) from Operations
rows.formula: div_afs_securities + equity_share_associate + reeval_impairment_afs + income_from_banks + prior_year_adj_associate + other_income

rows.label: Less: Expenses
General and Administrative Expenses
Financing Cost & Exchange Loss on Foreign Currencies
Zakat Payable
Total Expenses
Transfer to Statutory Reserve
Net Income (Loss) from Operation
Items Not To be Re-Classified to P/L
Comp. Share (Other Income/Loss in Associated Comp.)
Net Realized Gains/(Loss) from Sale of Avail. for Sale Securities
Re-evaluations (Fair Value) for Investment In An Associate
Re-evaluations (Fair Value) for Investment In Secu. for Sales
Total Profit/(Loss) Not Re-Classified to P/L
Net Movement in Invest. Through Other Comprehensive Income for the Year
Total Net Profit / (Loss) for the Year
